panels.description: Current blocking impact from the latest scheduled collection. Any non-zero result deserves review; an empty or stale collection does not reuse older blocking rows.

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
), blocked as (
  select b.*,
    s.seconds_in_wait,
    s.module as waiter_module
  from snapshot x
  join oracle_blocking_session_samples b
    on b.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
   and b.collected_at = x.collected_at
  left join oracle_session_samples s
    on s.source_database = b.source_database
   and s.collected_at = b.collected_at
   and s.inst_id = b.inst_id
   and s.sid = b.sid
)
select
  count(*)::bigint as blocked_sessions,
  count(distinct concat(blocking_instance, ':', blocking_session)) filter (
    where blocking_instance is not null
      and blocking_session is not null
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from blocked waiter
        where waiter.inst_id = blocked.blocking_instance
          and waiter.sid = blocked.blocking_session
      )
  )::bigint as root_blockers,
  coalesce(max(seconds_in_wait), 0)::bigint as longest_blocked_wait_seconds,
  count(distinct concat_ws('|', username, waiter_module))::bigint as affected_users_modules
from blocked;

panels.title: Current Blocking Impact

panels.description: Sampled blocker-to-waiter relationships observed during scheduled collections in the selected time range. A green No Locks detected band means successful collections found no blocking; a grey No successful collection data band means no successful collection was available. This is not an exact Oracle lock audit: locks shorter than the scheduled scrape interval may be missed, start and end boundaries are approximate, failed or missing collections appear as gaps, and the source is GV$SESSION blocking information rather than the complete GV$LOCK inventory. Shows the 20 most-observed relationships, paginated eight at a time for readability.

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot_sequence as (
  select collected_at,
         success,
         lag(collected_at) over (order by collected_at) as previous_snapshot_at,
         lead(collected_at) over (order by collected_at) as next_snapshot_at
  from oracle_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
), cadence as (
  select coalesce(
           percentile_cont(0.5) within group (
             order by extract(epoch from collected_at - previous_snapshot_at)
           ) filter (
             where previous_snapshot_at is not null
               and collected_at - previous_snapshot_at between interval '1 second' and interval '5 minutes'
           ),
           15.0
         ) as seconds
  from snapshot_sequence
), observations as (
  select b.collected_at,
         s.previous_snapshot_at,
         cadence.seconds as expected_interval_seconds,
         least(
           coalesce(s.next_snapshot_at, $__timeTo()),
           b.collected_at + cadence.seconds * interval '1 second'
         ) as observed_until,
         concat(
           coalesce(nullif(b.blocking_username, ''), '(unknown)'), ' [',
           coalesce(b.blocking_instance::text, '?'), ':',
           coalesce(b.blocking_session::text, '?'), '] -> ',
           coalesce(nullif(b.username, ''), '(unknown)'), ' [', b.inst_id, ':', b.sid, ',',
           coalesce(b.serial_number::text, '?'), '] | ',
           coalesce(nullif(b.event, ''), nullif(b.wait_class, ''), 'Blocked')
         ) as relationship,
         case
           when b.wait_class = 'Application' then 1
           when b.wait_class = 'Concurrency' then 2
           when b.wait_class = 'Cluster' then 3
           when b.wait_class in ('Configuration', 'Administrative') then 4
           else 5
         end as state
  from oracle_blocking_session_samples b
  join snapshot_sequence s on s.collected_at = b.collected_at
  cross join cadence
  where b.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and $__timeFilter(b.collected_at)
    and b.blocking_instance is not null
    and b.blocking_session is not null
), continuity as (
  select observations.*,
         lag(collected_at) over (
           partition by relationship, state order by collected_at
         ) as previous_observation_at
  from observations
), marked as (
  select continuity.*,
         sum(case
               when previous_observation_at is null
                 or previous_observation_at is distinct from previous_snapshot_at
                 or collected_at - previous_snapshot_at > expected_interval_seconds * 1.5 * interval '1 second'
               then 1 else 0
             end) over (
               partition by relationship, state order by collected_at
             ) as episode_id
  from continuity
), episodes as (
  select relationship, state, episode_id,
         min(collected_at) as episode_start,
         max(observed_until) as episode_end,
         count(*) as observations
  from marked
  group by relationship, state, episode_id
), selected_relationships as (
  select relationship
  from episodes
  group by relationship
  order by sum(observations) desc,
           sum(extract(epoch from episode_end - episode_start)) desc,
           relationship
  limit 20
), fallback as (
  select ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz as time, case when exists (select 1 from snapshot_sequence where success) then 'No Locks detected' else 'No successful collection data' end as metric,
         case when exists (select 1 from snapshot_sequence where success) then 0::double precision else 6::double precision end as value
  where not exists (select 1 from episodes)
  union all
  select ($__timeTo())::timestamptz as time, case when exists (select 1 from snapshot_sequence where success) then 'No Locks detected' else 'No successful collection data' end as metric, null::double precision as value
  where not exists (select 1 from episodes)
), timeline as (
  select episode_start as time, relationship as metric, state::double precision as value
  from episodes
  join selected_relationships using (relationship)
  union all
  select episode_end as time, relationship as metric, null::double precision as value
  from episodes
  join selected_relationships using (relationship)
  union all
  select time, metric, value
  from fallback
)
select time, metric, value
from timeline
order by time, metric;

panels.title: Blocking Relationships Over Time

panels.description: Current RAC-aware blocking relationships. Red nodes are root blockers, orange nodes both wait and block, and yellow nodes are blocked sessions. Edge labels show the wait event and current wait duration.

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
), relationships as (
  select b.*
  from snapshot x
  join oracle_blocking_session_samples b
    on b.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
   and b.collected_at = x.collected_at
), node_ids as (
  select inst_id, sid from relationships
  union
  select blocking_instance, blocking_session
  from relationships
  where blocking_instance is not null and blocking_session is not null
), classified as (
  select n.inst_id, n.sid,
    exists (
      select 1 from relationships r
      where r.inst_id = n.inst_id and r.sid = n.sid
    ) as is_waiter,
    exists (
      select 1 from relationships r
      where r.blocking_instance = n.inst_id and r.blocking_session = n.sid
    ) as is_blocker,
    (
      select count(*) from relationships r
      where r.blocking_instance = n.inst_id and r.blocking_session = n.sid
    ) as blocked_count
  from node_ids n
), enriched as (
  select c.*,
    coalesce(
      s.username,
      (select max(r.blocking_username) from relationships r
       where r.blocking_instance = c.inst_id and r.blocking_session = c.sid),
      '(unknown)'
    ) as username,
    coalesce(
      s.sql_id,
      (select max(r.blocking_sql_id) from relationships r
       where r.blocking_instance = c.inst_id and r.blocking_session = c.sid)
    ) as sql_id,
    coalesce(
      s.event,
      (select max(r.blocking_event) from relationships r
       where r.blocking_instance = c.inst_id and r.blocking_session = c.sid)
    ) as event,
    s.module,
    s.program,
    s.machine,
    s.seconds_in_wait
  from classified c
  left join snapshot x on true
  left join oracle_session_samples s
    on s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
   and s.collected_at = x.collected_at
   and s.inst_id = c.inst_id
   and s.sid = c.sid
)
select
  concat(inst_id, ':', sid) as id,
  concat(username, ' [', inst_id, ':', sid, ']') as title,
  coalesce(module, program, machine, 'No application context') as "subTitle",
  case
    when is_blocker and not is_waiter then 'ROOT BLOCKER'
    when is_blocker and is_waiter then 'INTERMEDIATE BLOCKER'
    else 'BLOCKED SESSION'
  end as "mainStat",
  case
    when is_blocker then concat(blocked_count, ' session', case when blocked_count = 1 then '' else 's' end, ' blocked')
    else coalesce(event, 'Waiting')
  end as "secondaryStat",
  case
    when is_blocker and not is_waiter then '#E02F44'
    when is_blocker and is_waiter then '#FF9830'
    else '#F2CC0C'
  end as color,
  sql_id as "detail__SQL ID",
  event as "detail__Wait event",
  module as "detail__Module",
  program as "detail__Program",
  machine as "detail__Machine",
  seconds_in_wait as "detail__Wait seconds"
from enriched
order by is_blocker desc, blocked_count desc, inst_id, sid;

with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
)
select
  concat(b.blocking_instance, ':', b.blocking_session, '->', b.inst_id, ':', b.sid) as id,
  concat(b.blocking_instance, ':', b.blocking_session) as source,
  concat(b.inst_id, ':', b.sid) as target,
  coalesce(b.event, 'Blocked') as "mainStat",
  case when s.seconds_in_wait is not null
    then concat(s.seconds_in_wait, ' s')
    else null
  end as "secondaryStat",
  case
    when coalesce(s.seconds_in_wait, 0) >= 60 then '#E02F44'
    when coalesce(s.seconds_in_wait, 0) >= 30 then '#FF9830'
    else '#F2CC0C'
  end as color,
  greatest(1, least(10, ln(coalesce(s.seconds_in_wait, 0) + 1)))::double precision as thickness,
  coalesce(s.seconds_in_wait, 0) >= 60 as highlighted
from snapshot x
join oracle_blocking_session_samples b
  on b.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
 and b.collected_at = x.collected_at
left join oracle_session_samples s
  on s.source_database = b.source_database
 and s.collected_at = b.collected_at
 and s.inst_id = b.inst_id
 and s.sid = b.sid
where b.blocking_instance is not null
  and b.blocking_session is not null
order by coalesce(s.seconds_in_wait, 0) desc, source, target;

panels.title: Current Blocking Chains

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
)
select
  b.inst_id,
  b.sid,
  b.serial_number,
  b.username,
  b.sql_id,
  b.event,
  b.wait_class,
  s.seconds_in_wait,
  s.module,
  s.machine,
  b.blocking_instance,
  b.blocking_session,
  b.blocking_username,
  b.blocking_sql_id,
  b.blocking_event
from snapshot x
join oracle_blocking_session_samples b
  on b.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
 and b.collected_at = x.collected_at
left join oracle_session_samples s
  on s.source_database = b.source_database
 and s.collected_at = b.collected_at
 and s.inst_id = b.inst_id
 and s.sid = b.sid
order by s.seconds_in_wait desc nulls last, b.inst_id, b.sid;

panels.title: Current Blocking Session Details
panels.description: Blocking relationships from exactly the latest scheduled collection. Cleared blocking incidents are not retained as current state.

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
)
select
  s.inst_id,
  s.sid,
  s.serial_number,
  s.username,
  s.sql_id,
  s.sql_child_number,
  s.event,
  s.wait_class,
  s.state,
  s.seconds_in_wait,
  s.module,
  s.action,
  s.program,
  s.machine,
  s.service_name
from snapshot x
join oracle_session_samples s
  on s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
 and s.collected_at = x.collected_at
where s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and s.sql_id is not null
order by s.seconds_in_wait desc nulls last, s.inst_id, s.sid;

panels.title: Current Active SQL Sessions
panels.description: Active SQL sessions from the latest scheduled collection.

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
)
select
  concat(coalesce(s.wait_class, 'UNKNOWN'), ' | ', coalesce(s.event, 'UNKNOWN')) as metric,
  count(*)::double precision as value
from snapshot x
join oracle_session_samples s
  on s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
 and s.collected_at = x.collected_at
where s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and coalesce(s.wait_class, 'Idle') <> 'Idle'
group by coalesce(s.wait_class, 'UNKNOWN'), coalesce(s.event, 'UNKNOWN')
order by value desc, metric
limit 20;

panels.title: Active Sessions by Current Wait Duration
panels.description: Active sessions ordered by the duration of their current wait. This is not SQL execution elapsed time.

targets.rawSql:
with snapshot as (
  select collected_at
  from oracle_latest_scrape_status
  where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and collector = 'scheduled'
    and $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  order by collected_at desc
  limit 1
)
select
  coalesce(s.status, 'UNKNOWN') as status,
  coalesce(s.username, '(background)') as username,
  coalesce(s.module, '(unknown)') as module,
  coalesce(s.program, '(unknown)') as program,
  count(*) as sessions,
  count(*) filter (where s.sql_id is not null) as sql_sessions,
  count(distinct s.machine) filter (where s.machine is not null) as machine_count,
  max(s.wait_class) as example_wait_class,
  max(s.event) as example_event
from snapshot x
join oracle_session_samples s
  on s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
 and s.collected_at = x.collected_at
group by coalesce(s.status, 'UNKNOWN'), coalesce(s.username, '(background)'),
  coalesce(s.module, '(unknown)'), coalesce(s.program, '(unknown)')
order by sessions desc
limit 100;
